title: [EOPATCH2] unable to change profile
symptom: User reports being unable to do a (temp) profile change on AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-c-nscv3. Another user reports same problem with eoPatch: after initial pairing profile changes worked, but after about 2 hours the profile was unable to switch back from a 130% temp profile.
cause: The pump does not accept profile change during active mode. Specifically, the function setNewBasalProfile returns early when a bolus is active, but also when a temp basal is active, which prevents profile changes.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (0c833d087ba0bdd57824cfa92a3fa28eb7d5db0c). A workaround is to suspend the pump from the eopatch screen and re-enable it, which allows the driver to set the profile again.
